description: Multisport is built around triathlon and its cousins (duathlon, aquathlon and aquabike): safety and health, a multi-week training plan, transitions and race distances, learning about athletes, and taking part in and volunteering at a sanctioned event.

safety.note: Open-water swims follow Safe Swim Defense; wear a helmet on the bike and train progressively.

outlineNote: Excerpts showed the topics (choosing one format, safety and first aid, health and nutrition, a training plan, transitions and race distances, and taking part in and volunteering at an event) but not their numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet.
